test_overview: Evaluated 6 test steps against the ComfortPro Connect app (localhost:8000) covering job rescheduling validation rules. ALL STEPS PASSED. (1) Created two guest bookings (Alex Guest A - Plumbing, Blake Guest B - HVAC) while signed out; each confirmation included a unique tracking link. Registered Technician Luca Moretti and converted both bookings to jobs: Job #1 (Aug 22, 2026 AM) and Job #2 (Aug 22, 2026 14:30 displayed as '2:30 PM'), both Scheduled and assigned to Luca Moretti. (2) Date validation: attempting to save Job A with a past date [today-7 = 2026-08-01] was rejected (date input min=today, HTML5 validation 'Value must be 08/08/2026 or later.', modal stayed open, schedule unchanged); rescheduling Job B to today (2026-08-08) AM succeeded. (3) Time validation: the reschedule time dropdown offers only AM/PM/Specific Time - 'Any' is not offered, matching the PRD. (4) Multiple reschedules: Job A rescheduled to Aug 22 PM, then again to Aug 22 10:00 (displayed '10:00 AM') - both saves succeeded; JOB_A_SCHEDULE_FINAL = Aug 22, 2026 at 10:00 AM. (5) Overlap: Job B rescheduled to the exact same schedule (Aug 22, 2026 10:00 AM) with no conflict detection; the Jobs list shows both jobs with identical schedules. (6) Guest access: signed out, opened TRACKING_LINK_A in a fresh no-login session - the tracking page displayed Job A's current schedule 'Aug 22, 2026 at 10:00 AM' (matching JOB_A_SCHEDULE_FINAL), with technician name, and the schedule was read-only with no edit controls. All fatal and non-fatal verifications passed. Final score: 60/60.
